generators.carrier: encoding of input x as initial word in the rewriting system
single-step rewriting of a word under R0 prime
extends R0 with erasing rules mapping every halting word to the fixed target word, giving R0 prime

relations.statement: R0 simulates the universal partial function: if (univFun x).Dom then startWord x reaches a halting word under R0.
relations.hypotheses: R0 faithfully encodes the machine computing univFun; no source declaration is available.

relations.statement: In R0 prime, every halting word reduces to target in finitely many steps.
relations.hypotheses: Erasing rules are added for every halting configuration form.

relations.statement: Reach R0 prime (startWord x) target implies a halting word is reachable from startWord x under R0, so the erasing rules do not create new reachability to target.
relations.hypotheses: Target is reachable only via erasing rules applied to halting words, and the erasing rules apply only to halting words. This must be proved; it is the crux of the bottleneck.

lemmas.statement: Reach R0' (startWord x) target iff (univFun x).Dom
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem bottleneck (x : Nat) : Reach R0' (startWord x) target ↔ (univFun x).Dom := by sorry

lemmas.statement: If (univFun x).Dom then Reach R0' (startWord x) target, via R_sim followed by R_erase.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem fwd (x : Nat) (h : (univFun x).Dom) : Reach R0' (startWord x) target := by sorry

lemmas.statement: If Reach R0' (startWord x) target then (univFun x).Dom, by conservativity of erasing rules.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem bwd (x : Nat) (h : Reach R0' (startWord x) target) : (univFun x).Dom := by sorry

near_misses.claim: Erasing rules that also apply to non-halting words make every start word reach target, so Reach becomes trivially true and decidable.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Erasing rules must fire only on halting configurations, so target reachability must imply halting.

near_misses.claim: R0 prime is confluent, so a word's normal form is unique.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: R0 prime is not assumed deterministic or confluent. Only reachability of target is claimed, not uniqueness of normal forms.

open_obligations: No source declarations are available, so Reach, startWord, univFun, R0 and R0' must all be defined from scratch.
Prove R_conservative: erasing rules must not allow target to be reached from a non-halting word, and the interaction of erasing rules with intermediate words of R0 needs a careful invariant.
Define the erasing rules concretely for all halting word shapes, and verify that this set is finite or at least computable.
The target is marked OPEN and is not proved here; the bottleneck is only a reduction goal.
